case_title: Kanchanben Purshottambhai Bhanderi v. State of Gujarat
statutory_provisions: IPC s.304B, s.498A; Dowry Prohibition Act s.3, s.4
aggravating_circumstances: Demand for dowry, mental and physical harassment
trial_court_outcome: Acquitted of accused No.3, convicted of accused No.1 and appellant
high_court_outcome: Acquitted of accused No.1, confirmed conviction of appellant
neutral_facts: The accused, who is the mother-in-law of the deceased, faced allegations of cruelty and demand for dowry. The deceased, a young woman, married into the accused's family and faced harassment and demands for dowry items from the accused and her husband. The deceased confided in her mother and other friends about the harassment. The deceased was found dead after consuming poison, and the post-mortem confirmed poisoning. The prosecution alleged that the accused and her son were responsible for the harassment and dowry demands. The trial court acquitted the father-in-law but convicted the accused and her son. The High Court acquitted the husband but confirmed the conviction of the accused. The Supreme Court upheld the conviction of the accused but reduced her sentence.
